memory_rows.narrative_pss_discrepancy: HALOGEN_RESULT.md and SIX_STACK_COMPARISON.md quote 78.16 GiB; raw smaps has Pss 83902270 KiB = 80.01544 GiB. Prefer raw correct KiB conversion.

caveats: All six stacks ran on Sozo Radeon 8060S / gfx1151. These compare complete pinned weights + runtime + settings, not isolated IU4 or quantization effects.
Each speed cell is a single valid observation. No repeat-qualified variance or significance is available.

Native grid uses fresh model load at every cell (18 per model), fixed 12960-token warmup with 32 outputs. Gufo/Halogen use one fresh owner per depth. HaloBox/AP retain one resident speed owner. Startup excluded from token rates.
Speed corpus is synthetic random-word/counting continuation and highly draftable. Natural-task generation is reported separately.
Full-prefix rows are separate cold-prefix setup requests with one output token. They are not fresh-prefix-plus-512-output runs and must not be pooled with append PP.
Native PP counts only useful new tokens and includes checkpoint replay (four tokens for depth>0). TG uses (outputs-1)/generation time; external server conventions and raw counters are retained.
Halogen early-EOS points: P512/D64000 emitted 1 token; P512/D120000 and P4096/D256000 emitted 121. Their PP remains measured; TG null, complete wall is not comparable with 512-output requests.
Gufo P2048/D192000 and D256000 cache snapshot costs are 19.01 and 22.63 seconds. Its stage PP/TG omit these but HTTP wall includes them; D256000 wall is 34.20 seconds.

Halogen refreshes the original prefix before each sibling append; ~45 seconds at 64K and ~201 seconds at 256K are excluded from request rates/wall. This is material for repeatedly branching workloads.

Objective quality is 2048 selected tail positions from 16 short windows; not deep-context quality or independent unseen validation. Teacher NLL 0.695658884 shared. Native width4 and full-width paths differ; external rows target-only.
HumanEval/0–9 is a SPEED TEST. Valid-response/completion-integrity counts do not measure correctness or quality. No generated code was executed.

Hermes verifier scores can coexist with incomplete agents. Report each pass score alongside completed cases, budget summaries and client errors. v5 pass1 joins preserved first13 cases and recovery14–20 after artifact-copy-only verifier fix.

GTT, RSS/PSS and system available RAM are overlapping UMA views; never sum. Halogen GTT~34.47 GiB coexists with resident D64K engine PSS 80.01544 GiB from raw smaps (the narrative reports 78.16 GiB) plus API 0.30329 GiB.
Native v4.4.1 P2048/D256000 wall exists in raw JSON: 20.417866 seconds, although SIX_STACK_COMPARISON.md leaves that summary cell blank.

Drafted/accepted counters have runtime-specific semantics. Halogen accepted may exceed its draft_n; do not plot accepted/drafted as a directly comparable acceptance ratio without semantic normalization.
